en: The image depicts a vintage, black and white postcard showing the facade of a large Gothic-style church with prominent pointed arches and high windows. The street in front is cobblestone, and a small cart is visible to the left. The church dominates the scene with its symmetrical towers and ornate architecture. The top of the card has the printed caption 'Bruges — L’Eglise St-Jacques.'
